nodes.label: CSS content-visibility for Long Lists
nodes.rationale: content-visibility: auto defers off-screen rendering; with 1000 messages the browser skips layout/paint for ~990 off-screen items (~10x faster initial render). contain-intrinsic-size reserves space to prevent scroll jump. Impact: HIGH.
